input.title: Structuring an option to facilitate replication with transaction costs
input.abstract: Using Leland's model of option valuation with transaction costs, it is shown that an interior solution does not exist which minimizes total transaction costs over the life of the option. However, it is possible to structure an option so as to reduce the change in the hedge ratio over time, and attack the replication or hedging costs from this direction. © 1989.

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
